doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Voucher Engine & General Ledger Core
doc.section: Story 3.2: Voucher Form (Create/Edit) – Line Item Engine
doc.snippet: Story 3.2 delivers the voucher form with keyboard-first editing, inline validation, draft auto-save, and voucher templates. Key features include one-line-per-entry UI design (each row = 1 debit account + 1 credit account + 1 amount), backend transformation (1 entry line → 2 voucher lines), template-based voucher creation, and comprehensive validation.

doc.title: Epic 3: Voucher Engine & General Ledger Core
doc.section: Story 3.2: Voucher Form (Create/Edit) – Line Item Engine
doc.snippet: As an accountant, I want to create and edit vouchers with line items, so that journal entries are always captured with full detail, accuracy, and compliance. Acceptance criteria cover keyboard navigation, inline validation, date picker with period validation, row operations, draft auto-save, undo functionality, and field-level error maps.

doc.title: Data Architecture
doc.snippet: Core transaction entities: vouchers (id, voucher_number, date, description, status, company_id), voucher_lines (id, voucher_id, account_id, debit, credit), journal_entries (id, voucher_id, account_id, debit, credit, period_id). Multi-tenancy via row-level filtering with company_id.

doc.title: Security Architecture
doc.snippet: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Admin, Accountant, Chief Accountant, CFO. Spring Security method-level security. API-level permission checks. Company-level data isolation.

doc.title: Architecture Decision Records
doc.snippet: Use Shadcn UI component library with Tailwind CSS for styling. Modern, accessible component library built on Radix UI primitives. TanStack Table integration for complex data grids.

artifact.reason: Existing voucher controller with GET, POST, PUT, DELETE endpoints. Provides patterns for company scoping, RBAC enforcement (@PreAuthorize), error handling, and response format. Story 3.2 will extend this controller with template endpoints and apply-template endpoint.

Existing voucher list page using TanStack Table, DataTablePro patterns, filter persistence (localStorage), error handling with retry buttons, and server-side pagination. Story 3.2 will create VoucherFormPage following similar patterns for consistency.

Frontend dependencies: React 19.1.1 (line 50), TanStack Table 8.21.3 (line 41), TanStack React Query 5.62.0 (line 40), shadcn/ui components via Radix UI primitives (lines 24-38), date-fns 4.1.0 (line 47), react-hook-form 7.66.0 (line 54), zod 4.1.12 (line 59). constraints.constraint: Keyboard-first voucher entry: Implement comprehensive keyboard navigation through header fields and line item grid with Tab/Enter/Arrow keys, auto-add row functionality, and keyboard shortcuts for row operations to enable efficient data entry workflows.

One-line-per-entry UI design: Each grid row represents one complete accounting entry with columns: STT, Tài khoản Nợ (Debit Account), Tài khoản Có (Credit Account), Mô tả (Description), Số tiền (Amount - single column), Dimensions. Backend transforms 1 entry line → 2 voucher lines (one debit, one credit) maintaining data integrity.

Inline validation and error display: Provide real-time validation feedback with inline error indicators (red border, error icon), tooltips for required fields and missing dimensions for both debit and credit accounts, and visual markers for invalid/incomplete lines to prevent posting until all validation passes.

Field-level error map API: Return detailed validation error responses with structure `{ lines: { [lineNumber]: { [field]: [errors] } } }` instead of generic 400 errors to enable precise error display and user guidance. Error fields can be: `debitAccount`, `creditAccount`, `amount`, `description`, or dimension fields.

Backend entry-to-lines transformation: When saving voucher, backend receives entry lines (each with debitAccount, creditAccount, amount) and transforms them into voucher lines (one debit line with debitAmount=amount, one credit line with creditAmount=amount). This transformation ensures double-entry balance automatically and maintains audit trail with proper line numbering.

Draft auto-save with optimistic updates: Implement optimistic UI updates with background persistence every 30 seconds or on blur, retry logic with exponential backoff, and edit lock management (clears if session lost >5 minutes) to ensure data integrity and user experience.
Performance targets: Support 20+ lines with virtual scrolling for smooth rendering, target 20 lines entered in <60 seconds for QA testing, and ensure draft auto-save completes in <1 second per NFR1.

Company scoping: All voucher operations enforce company-level isolation via `company_id` filtering and `CompanyScopeAspect`. RBAC: Accountant role can create/edit drafts; Chief Accountant can post/unpost; Admin has full access.
Reuse VoucherListPage patterns: Leverage the DataTablePro patterns, filter persistence, and error handling implementations from Story 3.1 to maintain UI consistency and code reuse.

Follow feature-first structure: Place VoucherFormPage under `frontend/src/features/accounting/pages/Vouchers/` and VoucherLineGrid under `frontend/src/components/voucher/` to align with feature-first architecture and maintain clear component boundaries.
